```{r}
#| label: load-packages-data
#| message: FALSE

library(shinydashboard)
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggthemes)
library(forcats)

school_safety <- read_sas("data/pu_ssocs18.sas7bdat")
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 20,base_family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible"))

```

```{r}
#| label: filter-data

# filter the data
# create final dataset to use

school_safety <- school_safety |>
  select(
    SCHID, # Unique school identifier
    INCPOL18, # Total number of incidents reported to police
    FR_URBAN, # Urbanicity - Based on urban-centric location of school
    FR_SIZE, # Size of school
    OUTSUS18, # suspensions
    C0183, # Social emotional learning training for students
    C0181, # Individual mentoring/tutoring/coaching by adults
    C0179, # Student involvement in restorative circles
    C0186, # Promote sense of community/social integration
    C0604, # LGBTQ acceptance group
    C0606, # Disability acceptance group
    C0608, # Cultural diversity acceptance group 
    C0190, # Formal process to obtain parental input
    C0192, # Provide training or assistance to parents
    C0204, # Community involvement - parent groups
    C0206, # Community involvement - social services
    C0208, # Community involvement - juvenile justice
    C0210, # Community involvement - law enforcement
    C0212, # Community involvement - mental health
    C0214, # Community involvement - civic organizations
    C0216, # Community involvement - businesses
    C0218, # Community involvement - religious organizations
    C0266, # Teacher training - classroom management
    C0268, # Teacher training - discipline policies related to violence
    C0265, # Teacher training - discipline policies related to cyberbullying
    C0267, # Teacher training - discipline policies related to bullying
    C0269, # Teacher training - alcohol/drug discipline policy
    C0270, # Teacher training - safety procedures
    C0272, # Teacher training - early warning signs for violent behavior
    C0278, # Teacher training - signs of self-harm or suicidal tendencies
    C0271, # Teacher training - intervention and referral strategies
    C0273, # Teacher training - recognize bullying behavior
    C0274, # Teacher training - student alcohol/drug abuse
    C0276, # Teacher training - positive behavioral intervention
    C0277, # Teacher training - crisis prevention and intervention
    C0610, # Sworn law enforcement officers at school
  )
school_safety <- school_safety |>
  mutate(
  C0183 = if_else(C0183 == 1, 1, 0), 
  C0181 = if_else(C0181 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0179 = if_else(C0179 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0186 = if_else(C0186 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0604 = if_else(C0604 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0606 = if_else(C0606 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0608 = if_else(C0608 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0190 = if_else(C0190 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0192 = if_else(C0192 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0204 = if_else(C0204 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0206 = if_else(C0206 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0208 = if_else(C0208 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0210 = if_else(C0210 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0212 = if_else(C0212 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0214 = if_else(C0214 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0216 = if_else(C0216 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0218 = if_else(C0218 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0266 = if_else(C0266 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0268 = if_else(C0268 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0265 = if_else(C0265 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0267 = if_else(C0267 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0269 = if_else(C0269 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0270 = if_else(C0270 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0272 = if_else(C0272 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0278 = if_else(C0278 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0271 = if_else(C0271 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0273 = if_else(C0273 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0274 = if_else(C0274 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0276 = if_else(C0276 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0277 = if_else(C0277 == 1, 1, 0),
  C0610 = if_else(C0610 == 1, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  group_by(SCHID)|> 
  mutate(resource_sum = C0183 + C0181 + C0179 + C0186 + C0604 + C0606 + C0608 + C0190 + C0192 + 
           C0204 + C0206 + C0208 + C0210 + C0212 + C0214 + C0216 + C0218 + C0266 + C0268 +
           C0265 + C0267 + C0269 + C0270 + C0272 + C0278 + C0271 + C0273 + C0274 + C0276 +
           C0277
    )

school_safety$C0183 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0183))
school_safety$C0181 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0181))
school_safety$C0179 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0179))
school_safety$C0186 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0186))
school_safety$C0604 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0604))
school_safety$C0606 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0606))
school_safety$C0608 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0608))
school_safety$C0190 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0190))
school_safety$C0192 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0192))
school_safety$C0204 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0204))
school_safety$C0206 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0206))
school_safety$C0208 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0208))
school_safety$C0210 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0210))
school_safety$C0212 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0212))
school_safety$C0214 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0214))
school_safety$C0216 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0216))
school_safety$C0218 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0218))
school_safety$C0266 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0266))
school_safety$C0268 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0268))
school_safety$C0265 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0265))
school_safety$C0267 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0267))
school_safety$C0269 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0269))
school_safety$C0270 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0270))
school_safety$C0272 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0272))
school_safety$C0278 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0278))
school_safety$C0271 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0271))
school_safety$C0273 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0273))
school_safety$C0274 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0274))
school_safety$C0276 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0276))
school_safety$C0277 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0277))
school_safety$C0610 <- as.logical(as.integer(school_safety$C0610))


```

```{r}
#| label: Average Incidents Reported to Police

average_incidents <- round(mean(school_safety$INCPOL18), digits = 1)

average_resource_score <- round(mean(school_safety$resource_sum), digits = 1)

total_schools <- nrow(school_safety)
```

# Mili plots

## Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| label: resource-incidents-plot

# all schools
school_safety |>
  ggplot(aes(x = resource_sum, y = INCPOL18)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of School Resources on Incidents Reported to Police", 
    x = "Amount of School Resources (out of 30)",
    y = "Total Number of Incidents Reported to the Police"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = as.factor(FR_URBAN)))

# City (1)
school_safety |>
  filter(FR_URBAN == 1) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = resource_sum, y = INCPOL18)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of School Resources on Incidents Reported to Police \n in Urban Schools", 
    x = "Amount of School Resources (out of 30)",
    y = "Total Number of Incidents Reported to the Police"
  ) 
 # geom_smooth()

# Suburb (2)
school_safety |>
  filter(FR_URBAN == 2) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = resource_sum, y = INCPOL18)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = 
      "Effect of School Resources on Incidents Reported to Police \n in Suburban Schools", 
    x = "Amount of School Resources (out of 30)",
    y = "Total Number of Incidents Reported to the Police"
  ) 
  #geom_smooth()

# Town (3)
school_safety |>
  filter(FR_URBAN == 3) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = resource_sum, y = INCPOL18)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of School Resources on Incidents Reported to Police \n in Town Schools", 
    x = "Amount of School Resources (out of 30)",
    y = "Total Number of Incidents Reported to the Police"
  ) 
 # geom_smooth()

# Rural (4)
school_safety |>
  filter(FR_URBAN == 4) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = resource_sum, y = INCPOL18)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of School Resources on Incidents Reported to Police \n in Rural Schools", 
    x = "Amount of School Resources (out of 30)",
    y = "Total Number of Incidents Reported to the Police"
  ) 
 # geom_smooth()
```

# Resources and suspension by Urbanicity

```{r}

# all schools
school_safety |>
  ggplot(aes(x = resource_sum, y = OUTSUS18)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of School Resources on Incidents Reported to Police", 
    x = "Amount of School Resources (out of 30)",
    y = "Total Number of Incidents Reported to the Police"
  ) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```
